Same treatment applied to the three remaining unambiguous wood/brass shapes, cut from the same two source materials with a new generic cutter script. log_well, exhaust_grate and the four wall_* shapes are still flat fill and still out of scope: ENGINE_PLAN §23 flags those as needing a new stone/vellum commission, not a cut of the timber/brass materials already on hand.

The two source materials are kept so the rest of the furniture can be cut from the same cloth.
